title: Joint Branch-Space Transform Coding for Diffusion Activation Quantization with Classifier-Free Guidance
title_zh: 面向扩散激活量化与无分类器引导的联合分支空间变换编码

paragraphs.en: Post-training quantization for diffusion models increasingly exploits timestep, feature, and layer structure. While recent work has begun incorporating CFG structure into diffusion quantization, activation quantization still operates independently across conditional and unconditional coordinates, leaving cross-activation structure unexploited. We show that matched CFG activations form a strongly correlated two-dimensional source and that, under a fixed bit budget, the choice of branch coding basis materially affects quantization fidelity. Motivated by this observation, we introduce branch-space transform coding , which rotates matched CFG branches via an offline derived 2 × 2 2\times 2 orthogonal matrix, requiring minimal modifications to model parameters or the quantization pipeline. We further derive the Guidance-Correlation Branch Transform (GCBT) , which jointly incorporates the CFG guidance direction and cross-branch second moments. Under an equal-rate quantization-noise surrogate, GCBT admits a closed-form per-layer solution without gradient optimization or angle search. Applied on top of existing diffusion PTQ methods, GCBT yields statistically significant fidelity gains in most evaluated comparisons with no statistically significant degradation, while leaving the underlying host quantization pipeline unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型的训练后量化越来越多地利用了时间步、特征和层结构。 尽管近期研究已开始将 CFG 结构融入扩散量化，但激活量化在条件坐标和无条件坐标之间仍独立进行，导致跨激活结构未被有效利用。 我们证明，匹配的 CFG 激活值构成了一个强相关性的二维源，并且在固定比特预算下，分支编码基的选择会显著影响量化保真度。 基于这一观察，我们提出了分支空间变换编码方法，该方法通过一个离线推导的 2×2 正交矩阵旋转匹配的 CFG 分支，且仅需对模型参数或量化流程进行最小程度的修改。 我们进一步推导出了引导相关性分支变换（GCBT），该方法联合融合了 CFG 引导方向和跨分支二阶矩。 在等速率量化噪声替代模型下，GCBT 能够给出每层的闭式解，无需梯度优化或角度搜索。 GCBT 可叠加应用于现有的扩散模型训练后量化方法中，在多数评估对比中实现了统计显著的保真度提升，且未出现统计显著的性能下降，同时保持底层主量化流程不变。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ; Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2021 ; Nichol and Dhariwal, 2021 ) achieve high generation quality at the cost of repeated, computationally heavy denoising steps. This has motivated extensive work on post-training quantization (PTQ) ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Shao et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Shafi and Suma, 2026 ) to reduce inference overhead via low-bit representations of weights and activations. Recent methods increasingly exploit activation structure during diffusion inference, exploiting (i) variation across denoising timesteps ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) , (ii) architectural and feature heterogeneity within the denoising model ( Li et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , and (iii) activation outliers ( Li et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . These advances raise a natural question: what additional structural information in diffusion inference can be exploited to improve activation quantization?
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型（Sohl-Dickstein 等人，2015；Ho 等人，2020；Song 等人，2021；Nichol 和 Dhariwal，2021）实现了高生成质量，但代价是重复且计算量巨大的去噪步骤。 这推动了大量关于训练后量化（PTQ）的研究（Chen 等人，2025；Li 等人，2023；Shao 等人，2026；Li 等人，2025；Zhao 等人，2025；Shafi 和 Suma，2026），旨在通过权重的低比特表示和激活值的低比特表示来减少推理开销。 近期方法越来越多地利用扩散推理过程中的激活结构，具体包括：（i）不同去噪时间步之间的差异（Chen 等人，2025；Zhao 等人，2025），（ii）去噪模型内部的架构和特征异质性（Li 等人，2023；Chen 等人，2025），以及（iii）激活值中的异常值（Li 等人，2025；Li 等人，2026）。 这些进展引出了一个自然的问题：扩散推理中还有哪些额外的结构信息可以被利用来改进激活量化？

paragraphs.en: One such structure is the paired computation in classifier-free guidance (CFG) ( Ho and Salimans, 2022 ) . CFG plays a central role in modern diffusion pipelines by strengthening the influence of the condition on generation. At each denoising step, CFG evaluates the same model weights with and without condition, producing matched predictions p c p_{c} and p u p_{u} and then combining them using a guidance scale s s . We denote the corresponding activations as X c X_{c} and X u X_{u} , and refer to the two-dimensional axis formed by this matched pair as the CFG branch space .
paragraphs.zh: 其中一种结构是分类器自由引导（CFG）中的成对计算（Ho 和 Salimans，2022）。 CFG 在现代扩散流程中扮演着核心角色，通过增强条件对生成过程的影响来实现这一点。 在每个去噪步骤中，CFG 会分别使用有条件和无条件的情况评估相同的模型权重，从而得到匹配的预测值 p c p_{c} 和 p u p_{u}，然后利用引导系数 s s 将它们组合起来。 我们将相应的激活值表示为 X c X_{c} 和 X u X_{u}，并将由这对匹配值构成的二维轴称为 CFG 分支空间。

paragraphs.en: While recent work has begun incorporating CFG into post-training calibration ( Shao et al., 2026 ; Shafi and Suma, 2026 ) , activation quantization still typically operates on X c X_{c} and X u X_{u} independently in separate branch coordinates. This choice implicitly fixes the branch basis, overlooking the fact that both activations arise from matched CFG passes through the same model weights.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管近期的研究已开始将 CFG 融入训练后校准（Shao et al., 2026；Shafi and Suma, 2026），但激活量化通常仍对 X c X_{c} 和 X u X_{u} 在独立的分支坐标中分别进行操作。 这种选择隐式地固定了分支基矢，忽略了两个激活值实际上都源于通过相同模型权重的匹配 CFG 流程这一事实。

paragraphs.en: We find two properties of this branch space that are relevant to activation quantization. First, matched X c X_{c} and X u X_{u} activations are strongly correlated, exhibiting cross-branch correlation coefficients of a median uncentered correlation of 0.86 (vs. 0.33 for mismatched pairs) across DiT-XL/2 ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) layers (Figure 2 ). Second, the two CFG branches are coupled at the model output by the known guidance direction g s = [ s , 1 − s ] ⊤ g_{s}=[s,1-s]^{\top} , which varies with the guidance scale s s . As illustrated in Figure 3 , standard PTQ quantizes activations independently along native branch axes, imposing a structural mismatch between the quantization grid, principal activation variance, and the guidance vector g s g_{s} . Under a fixed activation-bit budget, this directional mismatch limits quantization fidelity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现该分支空间具有两个与激活量化相关的特性。 首先，匹配的 X c X_{c} 和 X u X_{u} 激活值高度相关，在 DiT-XL/2（Peebles 和 Xie，2023）各层中，其跨分支相关系数的非中心化相关系数中位数为 0.86（而非匹配对为 0.33）（图 2）。 其次，两个 CFG 分支通过已知的引导方向 g s = [ s , 1 − s ] ⊤ g_{s}=[s,1-s]^{\top} 在模型输出端耦合，该方向随引导尺度 s s 变化。 如图 3 所示，标准的 PTQ 方法沿原始分支轴独立量化激活值，导致量化网格、主要激活方差和引导向量 g s g_{s} 之间出现结构性不匹配。 在固定激活位预算的情况下，这种方向性不匹配会限制量化的保真度。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by these observations, we introduce branch-space transform coding . Before activation quantization, we apply a 2 × 2 2\times 2 orthogonal branch rotation matrix ( R R ) across each matched conditional/unconditional pair, quantize the transformed activations on top of the existing low-bit quantizer, and invert the transform afterward. The procedure does not change model parameters, nominal activation precision, or the number of quantized values; it changes only the branch coordinates in which activation quantization is performed. Branch-space coding is therefore complementary to existing timestep-, feature-, layer-, and precision-aware diffusion PTQ methods.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这些观察，我们提出了分支空间变换编码。 在激活量化之前，我们对每个匹配的有/无条件对应用一个 2×2 正交分支旋转矩阵（R），在现有的低比特量化器基础上对变换后的激活值进行量化，并在之后对变换进行逆变换。 该过程不会改变模型参数、名义上的激活精度或量化值的数量；它仅改变执行激活量化的分支坐标。 因此，分支空间编码与现有的基于时间步、特征、层和精度的扩散 PTQ 方法互为补充。

paragraphs.en: To determine the optimal rotation matrix R R , we derive the Guidance-Correlation Branch Transform (GCBT) , which jointly incorporates the CFG guidance direction and per-layer cross-branch second moments. Under an equal-rate quantization-noise surrogate, this formulation yields a closed-form per-layer solution without gradient optimization or angle search. Across diverse diffusion PTQ backbones, models, and datasets, GCBT consistently improves reconstruction and perceptual fidelity, establishing CFG branch space as a complementary axis for activation quantization.

paragraphs.en: Our work makes the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作做出了以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: CFG Branch Space as a Design Axis. To our knowledge, we are the first to treat the CFG branch axis as an explicit coding space, demonstrating that cross-branch structure between matched activations directly governs quantization fidelity.

paragraphs.en: Diffusion PTQ increasingly exploits structure specific to iterative generation. Q-Diffusion ( Li et al., 2023 ) addresses timestep-dependent activation distributions and architectural outliers, while Q-DiT ( Chen et al., 2025 ) and ViDiT-Q ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) further account for spatial, temporal, layer, and channel variation in Diffusion Transformers. SVDQuant ( Li et al., 2025 ) handles activation outliers through smoothing and low-rank compensation, and DeltaQuant ( Li et al., 2026 ) exploits spatiotemporal activation structure for low-bit video diffusion. These methods adapt quantization to diffusion-specific activation structure, but retain the native conditional/unconditional branch coordinates during activation quantization.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散 PTQ 越来越多地利用迭代生成特有的结构。 Q-Diffusion（Li 等人，2023）解决了与时间步相关的激活分布和架构异常值问题，而 Q-DiT（Chen 等人，2025）和 ViDiT-Q（Zhao 等人，2025）则进一步考虑了扩散 Transformer 中的空间、时间、层和通道变化。 SVDQuant（Li 等人，2025）通过平滑和低秩补偿处理激活异常值，而 DeltaQuant（Li 等人，2026）则利用时空激活结构实现低比特视频扩散。 这些方法将量化适配于扩散特有的激活结构，但在激活量化过程中保留了原始的有条件/无条件分支坐标。

paragraphs.en: Rotary quantization has been widely studied beyond diffusion models. QuaRot ( Ashkboos et al., 2024 ) applies orthogonal rotations to reduce activation outliers, while SpinQuant ( Liu et al., 2025 ) learns rotation matrices for improved low-bit quantization. Related methods use Hadamard-based incoherence processing ( Tseng et al., 2024 ) or learnable linear transformations ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ) to improve the quantizability of weights and activations. In diffusion models, TR-DQ ( Shao et al., 2026 ) introduces timestep-dependent feature rotations, while OrbitQuant ( Lee et al., 2026 ) quantizes in a normalized rotated basis. These approaches transform feature or hidden-state coordinates; in contrast, our transform acts across the two-dimensional CFG branch axis while leaving token and feature coordinates unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 旋转量化在扩散模型之外的领域也得到了广泛研究。 QuaRot（Ashkboos 等人，2024）通过应用正交旋转来减少激活值中的异常值，而 SpinQuant（Liu 等人，2025）则学习旋转矩阵以实现更优的低位量化。 相关方法采用基于哈达玛矩阵的非相干性处理（Tseng 等人，2024），或使用可学习的线性变换（Sun 等人，2025；Hu 等人，2025），以提升权值和激活值的可量化性。 在扩散模型中，TR-DQ（Shao 等人，2026）引入了与时间步相关的特征旋转，而 OrbitQuant（Lee 等人，2026）则在归一化的旋转基下执行量化。 这些方法会改变特征或隐藏状态的坐标；相比之下，我们的变换作用于二维 CFG 分支轴，同时保持标记和特征坐标不变。

paragraphs.en: Recent diffusion PTQ methods have also begun to exploit the relation between CFG branches. TR-DQ ( Shao et al., 2026 ) uses redundancy across CFG executions, while guidance-aware methods such as GAMP ( Shafi and Suma, 2026 ) calibrate quantization with respect to the guided prediction and CFG sensitivity. These methods incorporate CFG structure while retaining the native conditional/unconditional branch basis. Our work studies a complementary variable: the branch coding basis itself. We treat the CFG branch axis as an explicit quantization space and select its basis from the CFG branch direction and cross-branch second moments.

paragraphs.en: The video experiments extend this pattern beyond image generation and, more importantly, beyond teacher-referenced reconstruction alone. Across Wan2.1, CogVideoX, and OpenSora, GCBT improves both FP-referenced fidelity and VBench generation-quality metrics. The effect persists on the larger Wan2.1-T2V-14B model, showing that the branch-space benefit transfers across video architectures, PTQ hosts, and model scales. paragraphs.en: We identify CFG branch space as an overlooked coding dimension for diffusion activation quantization and introduce GCBT, a closed-form transform that jointly exploits matched-branch geometry and guidance sensitivity. Across many settings, GCBT consistently yields favorable fidelity and generation-quality improvements without modifying model parameters or the underlying quantization pipeline. These results establish branch-space coding as a lightweight and complementary design axis for diffusion PTQ, with negligible runtime and memory overhead.

paragraphs.en: For video, we use a fixed n = 256 n=256 subset of VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , stratified by category. Prompt subsets and generation seeds are fixed once and reused for the full-precision reference, Host PTQ, and Host+GCBT. Within each paired comparison, the checkpoint, host configuration, bitwidth, CFG scale, sampling steps, resolution, and generation seed are identical; only GCBT is changed. Framewise fidelity metrics are averaged within each clip, with prompts treated as the paired statistical units.

paragraphs.en: The relatively high BF16-referenced LPIPS on Wan is not specific to GCBT: it is already present in the OrbitQuant baseline. In video diffusion, quantization can shift the sampling trajectory enough to produce a different yet still prompt-consistent realization, making frame-aligned distance to a single BF16 sample large even when visual quality remains good. Figure 7 illustrates this behavior. Accordingly, we interpret LPIPS here as BF16-reference fidelity rather than standalone generation quality, and report VBench metrics alongside it.
paragraphs.zh: Wan 模型在 BF16 参考下的 LPIPS 值相对较高，但这并非 GCBT 所独有：OrbitQuant 基线模型中已经存在这一现象。 在视频扩散过程中，量化可能会使采样轨迹发生足够大的偏移，从而生成一个不同但依然与提示一致的输出结果，这会导致即使视觉质量良好，与单个 BF16 样本的帧对齐距离仍然很大。 图 7 展示了这种行为。 因此，我们将此处的 LPIPS 解释为相对于 BF16 参考的保真度，而非独立的生成质量，并同时将 VBench 指标一并报告。

paragraphs.en: GCBT has several scope limitations. First, its closed-form optimality is derived under the equal-rate quantization-noise surrogate in Sec. 3.3, which assumes that transformed-coordinate quantization error scales with projected second moments and neglects cross-coordinate error terms. The resulting rotation is therefore optimal for this surrogate, rather than being guaranteed to minimize the exact distortion of every host quantizer or end-to-end generation error.
paragraphs.zh: GCBT 存在若干范围限制。 首先，其闭式最优性是在第 3.3 节中基于等速率量化噪声代理模型推导得出的，该模型假设变换坐标的量化误差与投影二阶矩成比例，并忽略了跨坐标的误差项。 因此，由此得到的旋转是针对该代理模型的最优解，而非保证能够最小化每个主量化器或端到端生成过程的精确失真。

paragraphs.en: Second, GCBT requires an explicit matched conditional–unconditional branch pair and is therefore directly applicable to inference pipelines with active two-branch CFG. We do not study distilled or single-pass guidance schemes, nor timestep-varying or dynamic CFG schedules.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，GCBT 需要一个明确的匹配的条件–无条件分支对，因此可以直接应用于具有活跃双分支 CFG 的推理流程。 我们不研究蒸馏或单通引导方案，也不研究随时间步变化或动态的 CFG 调度方案。

paragraphs.en: Finally, our CFG-aware comparison uses a GAMP-inspired calibration that we implemented ourselves because no public implementation of GAMP is available. This experiment should therefore be interpreted as evidence that GCBT remains complementary to guided-output calibration, rather than as an official reproduction of GAMP; results with the original implementation may differ.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们的 CFG 感知比较方法使用了一种受 GAMP 启发的校准机制，该机制由我们自己实现，因为目前还没有可用的公开 GAMP 实现。 因此，这项实验应被解释为证据，表明 GCBT 仍然是引导输出校准的补充方法，而非对 GAMP 的官方复现；使用原始实现得到的结果可能会有所不同。
